units.source_text: 那天你写在扇子上送我的诗，有‘夕颜凝露容光艳’之句，

en.t: In the poem you wrote on the fan and gave to me that day, there was a line about the evening face flower glistening with dew and looking lovely,

units.source_text: 现在我露真面目了，你看怎样？”

en.t: Now that I have shown you my true face, what do you think?"

units.source_text: 夕颜向他瞟一眼，低声答道：

en.t: Yugao glanced at him and answered softly:
